summary: Decoy Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce a change in its 2026 Annual Meeting date to July 14, 2026, and establish related stockholder proposal and director nomination deadlines. This is a routine procedural notice under Rules 14a-5(f) and 14a-8, setting record and submission dates. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or management change is disclosed. The filing is purely administrative and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
